description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named SeconderyProductsSkelton, which displays a horizontally scrollable list of placeholder widgets (Skeletons) for secondary products in an e-commerce app. It uses constants for padding and references another widget, SeconderyProductSkelton.

classes.name: SeconderyProductsSkelton
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a horizontal list of secondary product skeleton placeholders for loading UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for SeconderyProductsSkelton, returning a SizedBox containing a horizontally scrollable list of skeleton widgets.
